attBesluta.text: These are amazing for the price. Very well built. I've got 4 of them now in various projects.

Bought it to mount a battery in my car-hauler enclosed trailer. The quality of the stainless is good. A lot of work and time consuming to remove the protective covering. Assembly INSTRUCTIONS need to be significantly better. Especially regards the sides. They should be numbered 1,2,3,4 regards where they go in assembly. Will only fit PROPERLY, in one way. The Top is still difficult to fit correctly. Once together CORRECTLY, it is a nice battery box, and I like the numerous holes for wire entry an exit! But due to the sharpness of the metal make sure to install the plugs for each opening! A Must!
I wasn't expecting to have to assemble it since it was shipped flat packed. Assembled easily though and looks to be a very good product and I would recommend this product
